what: caliber: monotone calibration of a digital measure to a multi-item PRO — caliber-package
title: caliber: monotone calibration of a digital measure to a multi-item PRO — caliber-package
text: One latent trait \(\eta \sim N(0, 1)\) drives ordinal multi-item PRO (logistic graded response model, items scored 0 3) continuous digital performance measure \(y\): $$\mathrm{logit}\, P(C_j \ge k \mid \eta) = a_j \eta + d_{jk}, \qquad   y = \mu(\eta) + e, \quad e \sim N(0, \sigma(\eta)^2), \quad   \log \sigma(\eta) = g_0 + g_1 \eta,$$ \(\mu(\eta) = \sum_m \beta_m B_m(\eta)\) non-increasing cubic B-spline (24 coefficients, 20 interior knots \([-4, 4]\)). Higher \(\eta\) means PRO construct (worse sleep, mobility difficulty); digital measure falls \(\eta\) rises.

title: caliber: monotone calibration of a digital measure to a multi-item PRO — caliber-package
text: curve fitted monotonic likelihood boosting B-splines (Leitenstorfer Tutz 2007) AIC stop, one three ways differ \(\eta\) handled (see [fit_ms()]): MS-Joint concurrent calibration: GRM items curve estimated     together, \(\eta\) integrated \(p(\eta \mid C, y)\); MS-EAP EAP plug-: GRM PRO alone, EAP scores treated     known; MS-Fixed fixed-item calibration: GRM PRO alone, items     fixed, \(\eta\) integrated (recommended primary analysis). Throughout code digital measure called `sqi` (sleep-quality index worked example); continuous measure falls latent trait can used (gait speed NHANES example).

"joint"  MS-Joint. Items start GRM estimates. item M-step taken every           `item_every` iterations (default 5); skipping keeps           every iteration generalised EM step, items settle long           AIC stop.  "eap"    MS-EAP. EAP scores PSQI-GRM treated           covariate: paper's algorithm exactly published (observed           covariate, normal response). Residual SD: hetero = TRUE (default) log sigma(eta) = g0 + g1 eta. sigma step updates (g0, g1) Newton steps posterior-expected (MS-EAP: observed) log-likelihood given curve, units weighted 1 / sigma_u^2 fitting step, (g0, g1) counted tr(H_l) (number fixed, AIC minimum move). hetero = FALSE sigma constant, closed-form update. Stopping: AIC(l) = Dev_l + 2 tr(H_l), H_l = - (- M_l)...(- M_0) approximate hat matrix person-level fitted values (paper eq. 11). Dev_l -2 log L(C, SQI) eta integrated ("fixed", "joint") -2 log L(SQI | EAP) ("eap"). "joint" 28 item parameters counted tr(H_l); number every iteration, AIC minimum move.
